tools.name: clmm_range_stats
tools.title: Which range to hold in a concentrated pool
tools.description: For Raydium CLMM, Orca Whirlpool and Meteora DLMM: liquidity by price, share of time a range of the given width would have stayed in range over 7 and 30 days, fee yield inside the range, impermanent loss and how many rebalances it would have needed. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.020 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

width_pct.description: Full range width in percent of the current price

tools.name: describe_address
tools.title: Describe a Solana address
tools.description: Free. Call first with any Solana address to learn what it is: wallet, program, pool or token, its age, activity and basic stats. Points to the paid tool that answers the next question (wallet_check, pool_health, token_deep_check). Price: free.

tools.name: market_snapshot
tools.title: Perp venues and execution cost in one answer
tools.description: Funding, open interest, liquidations and order book depth for a ticker across Binance, Bybit, OKX, Hyperliquid and Drift, price and funding divergence, and the all-in cost of an order of the given size on each venue and on Jupiter with the cheapest venue. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.010 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

tools.name: new_launches
tools.title: Fresh Solana launches, already checked
tools.description: New tokens and pools on Solana (pump.fun, LetsBonk, Raydium LaunchLab, Meteora DBC, PumpSwap, Raydium AMM and CPMM) from the last N minutes with mint and freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions that can trap holders, liquidity and lock, price and market cap (pump.fun curves and AMM pools) with pump.fun curve progress, creator history and links to past collapses, and the first-buyer funding graph: same-block buyers, wallets funded by the creator or by one shared address, known snipers. Each launch has a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Up to 20 launches per answer, or as many as the plan's batch size. Windows over 60 minutes or more than 20 launches cost more. Price: 0.005 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

limit.description: Launches to return: up to 20, or up to the plan's batch size (max_batch in /billing/plans)

platforms.description: Comma separated: pump_fun, letsbonk, raydium_launchlab, meteora_dbc, pump_swap, raydium_amm_v4, raydium_cpmm

tools.name: new_launches_batch
tools.title: Launch checks for a list of mints
tools.description: The same checks as new_launches (authorities, Token-2022 extensions, liquidity and lock, price and market cap, creator history, first-buyer funding graph) for Solana token mints you already know about, in one call: up to 5 on Free, 50 when paid per call, or the plan's batch size (max_batch in /billing/plans). Each launch has a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.015 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

mints.description: Up to 50 mints paid per call, or up to the plan's batch size

tools.name: pool_health
tools.title: Real pool yield after impermanent loss
tools.description: For Raydium AMM, CPMM and CLMM, Orca Whirlpool, Meteora DLMM and PumpSwap pools: depth within 2%, slippage for $1k and $10k, 24h liquidity inflow or outflow, LP return versus holding over 7 and 30 days after impermanent loss, bot and sandwich share of volume. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

tools.name: score_performance
tools.title: Measured accuracy of our flags
tools.description: Free. For every launch risk flag we publish: how often flagged tokens collapsed within 24h versus the base rate across all launches, sample size, test window and daily drift. Price: free.

days.description: Test window in days, rounded up to 1, 7, 30 or 90

tools.name: service_stats
tools.title: Service reputation
tools.description: Free. Calls, unique payers, paid volume, uptime and latency of this service over 24h, 7d and 30d. Check before paying. Price: free.

tools.name: swap_preflight
tools.title: Is this swap safe to execute now
tools.description: Before a Solana swap: price impact on the best route, sandwich share on the pool from our history, Token-2022 transfer fees, hooks and permanent delegate, mint and freeze authority. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid) with reasons, and the assessment behind it (ok, unverified, high_slippage_risk, high_sandwich_risk, blocked). Price: 0.005 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

amount.description: Amount in quote units for buy, in token units for sell

tools.name: token_deep_check
tools.title: Holder graph and history for a token
tools.description: Use before buying or holding a Solana token to see who really holds it: which top holders were funded from the same address, real concentration after merging linked wallets, holder and liquidity dynamics from our snapshot history, blacklist proximity within two transfers, and the mint's authorities and Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, hook, permanent delegate). Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Goes deeper than a single safety score such as RugCheck's. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

tools.name: token_holders_delta
tools.title: Who entered and left the top holders
tools.description: Use to see whether insiders are leaving a Solana token: top holder changes over 1h and 24h from our snapshots, new and exited holders, concentration shift and large holders selling. Returns a verdict (ok, caution, avoid, or unknown when data is missing) with reasons. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.

tools.name: wallet_check
tools.title: Should I deal with this address
tools.description: One verdict with reasons for a Solana address: known exchange or not, age, activity, bot or human, PnL on fresh launches, exchange funding, OFAC and hack links up to two hops. Price: 0.030 USDC per call, included in subscriptions.
